article.title: Global Prevalence of Clinically Significant Insomnia Among Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
article.authors: Du T, Luo L, Gao L
article.abstract: Clinically significant insomnia is associated with multiple adverse health outcomes in cancer patients. This study aimed to examine the global prevalence of clinically significant insomnia among cancer patients and to determine the moderators of the prevalence estimate.
